''For a summary of all translated versions of The Wheel of Time see [[The Wheel of Time translations]].''

The Wheel of Time in Hungarian is ''Az Idő Kereke''. It has been published by both Beholder and Delta Vision in Hungary, mainly with each corresponding English volume split into two. Each part is simply named ''első kötet'' and ''második kötet'' (volume one and volume two), along with the Hungarian translation of the book titles. Translators for the project are listed as Dr. Attila Würth, Alíz Radnóti, Csaba A. Varga, Tamás Bátori, Ágnes Körmendi and Béla Csaba Varga. Publication began in 1998.<ref name=wikihun>[https://hu.wikipedia.org/wiki/Az_Id%C5%91_Kereke Wheel of Time on Hungarian Wikipedia]</ref>

==Book titles==
The book titles in Hungarian, their first publication date, translator and publisher(s) is as follows:<ref name=wikihun></ref>
* '''New Spring''' ''Új tavasz'': Körmendi, Ágnes; Beholder (2005)
#'''The Eye of the World''' ''A világ szeme'': Würth Attila; Beholder (1998)
# '''The Great Hunt''' ''A nagy hajtóvadászat'': Würth, Attila; Beholder (1999)
# '''The Dragon Reborn''' ''Az újjászületett Sárkány'': Radnóti, Alíz; Beholder (2000 )
# '''The Shadow Rising''' ''Hódít az árnyék'': Radnóti, Alíz; Beholder (2000)
# '''The Fires of Heaven''' ''Mennyei tűz'': Radnóti, Alíz, Varga, Csaba; Beholder (2001)
# '''Lord of Chaos''' ''A káosz ura'': Bátori, Tamás; Beholder (2001–2002)
# '''A Crown of Swords''' ''A kardok koronája'': Körmendi, Ágnes; Beholder (2002)
# '''The Path of Daggers''' ''A tőrök útja'': Körmendi, Ágnes; Beholder (2003)
# '''Winter's Heart''' ''A tél szíve'': Körmendi, Ágnes; Beholder (2003)
# '''Crossroads of Twilight''' ''Az alkony keresztútján'': Körmendi, Ágnes; Beholder (2004)
# '''Knife of Dreams''' ''Álmok tőre'': Körmendi, Ágnes; Beholder (2006)
# '''The Gathering Storm''' ''Gyülekező fellegek'': Körmendi, Ágnes; Delta Vision (2012)
# '''Towers of Midnight''' ''Az éjfél tornyai'': Varga, Béla; Delta Vision (2012)
# '''A Memory of Light''' ''A fény emlékezete'': Varga, Béla; Delta Vision (2014)

==Book covers==

===Delta Vision===
These versions use the same art as the ebook versions in English, with the exception of The Eye of the World and The Great Hunt. They also have different backgroud colours than the English editions. Each volume is split into two parts with the same illustration.
